exceptions.reason: The new core counts tokens only with an upstream's own count endpoint, and the Codex endpoint has none, so it answers that the account cannot count; today's core answers with a local tokenizer estimate. A local estimate would need a tokenizer and its vocabularies in the core for a number that is only approximate, so it is left out.
